questions.question: What will be the output of the following pseudocode?
questions.code:
Integer a, b, c, out
Set a = 18, b = 12, c = 6
Set out = (a & b) + (b ^ c) - (a mod c)
Print out

questions.question: What will be the output of the following pseudocode?
questions.code:
Integer a, b, c, res
Set a = 25, b = 15, c = 5
if(a > b AND b > c)
    Set res = (a - b) * c
else if(a < b OR c > 10)
    Set res = (b - c) * 2
else
    Set res = a + b + c
End if
Print res
questions.explanation: Testing conditions: (25 > 15 AND 15 > 5) is True. Branch taken computes 50.

questions.question: What will be the output of the following pseudocode?
questions.code:
Integer val, x
Set val = 0, x = 16
while(x > 0)
    Set val = val + (x ^ 8)
    Set x = x - 5
End while
Print val
questions.explanation: x starts at 16 and steps down by 5. Accumulating (x ^ 8) at each step yields 50.

questions.question: What will be the output of the following pseudocode?
questions.code:
Integer solve(Integer p, Integer q)
    if(q <= 1)
        return p
    End if
    return p + solve(p, q - 1)
End function solve

Integer ans
Set ans = solve(8, 4)
Print ans
questions.explanation: solve(p, q) is a recursive multiplication of p by q. solve(8, 4) = 32.
